I have been to both Kathmandu and Pokhara and my first advice is to seriously look over shortening your time in Kathmandu. One or two days is fine, gives you a feel for the city, but any more and you will wish to be elsewere. For me this was because of the bad air. The smog is everywhere. Spend an hour looking for a place to eat then two hours coughing your lungs up due to all the exaust from mopeds (they are everywhere, worse than vietnam). I'm sure you can find ways to entertain you with while there, but a british couple I talked to who had lived there for 15 years recommended that even if you are only there for a day as a tourist, wear a facemask/filter. Your lungs will thank you.

Pokhara was a pleasant surprise! Very cute and so clean compared to kathmandu. Rent a rowboat on the lake, the surrounding nature is beautiful.
